== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. The Alternate Image printings have their own table, [[Template:Card errata/Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (ALT)]]. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
